prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: photorealistic landscape gym exercise scene for a printed Full Muscle GF brochure, final placement 62 x 32 mm. Produce a wide landscape image approximately 2:1 (1536 x 768 preferred), with the ENTIRE machine and ENTIRE adult man visible and safe margin at top and bottom.
Input image 1 is the binding identity reference for the exact GF-004 plate-loaded leverage lat pulldown machine. Input image 2 is ONLY an architectural/environment mood reference for the G5 gym: warm pale concrete walls, tall black-framed daylight windows, charcoal rubber floor, restrained warm linear ceiling lighting and subtle greenery. DO NOT copy or introduce the G5 machines from image 2. Input image 3 is the exact brand artwork reference.
Scene: Place exactly the GF-004 machine from image 1 in a clean modern premium gym matching that architectural mood. Show the machine in a natural three-quarter view close to image 1; leave enough surrounding floor and background for a wide editorial crop, while keeping the machine the clear main subject. Keep the scene uncluttered; any distant gym objects must be out of focus and cannot obscure the GF machine.
Action: one adult athletic man in his early 30s wearing a plain charcoal fitted short-sleeve training shirt, charcoal training trousers and neutral athletic shoes, plausibly USING THIS EXACT GF-004 machine. His pelvis is supported on its real small seat, thighs and knees secured UNDER the existing two black thigh-restraint rollers, both feet firmly on the floor. His torso is upright with a slight natural backward lean and his head neutral. Both hands grasp the REAL black angled handgrips of the existing wide curved pulldown bar with a wide symmetrical overhand grip. Show the start/early portion of a controlled pull IN FRONT of the head toward the upper chest, elbows slightly bent and beginning to travel down. Do not show a behind-neck pull. Use the actual existing connected bar, which remains mechanically connected to the same overhead lever linkage; only plausible rotation of existing moving parts for this exercise pose is allowed. Clearly natural human anatomy and contact points: two arms, two hands, two legs, five natural fingers per hand, no body-frame intersections.
Machine identity and invariants: retain EXACTGF-004 black angled uprights and triangular base/feet, two long green overhead leverage arms and connecting green crossmember, visible black linkage rods and hinges, the same black curved pull bar and its grips, small black seat and two cylindrical black thigh pads, silver plate-loading horns, bolts and hardware. No weight stack, no cable tower, no added pulley housing, no altered frame, no extra handles, no redesign, no swapped seat. Keep the green-painted arms and black frame color from image1. Keep the existing perspective-fitted logo on the near upper arm, with 'Full' white, 'Muscle' light green #79a64b, small 'EQUIPMENT' white exactly as reference3. Never replace it with all-white text. No floating logos, borders, captions, page graphics or watermark.
Lighting/materials: convincing high-quality professional interior photograph, soft daylight and restrained warm overhead light, realistic skin and charcoal clothing, crisp readable machine shape, accurate contact shadows on rubber floor. Preserve the machine proportions and mechanical construction, the human action must adapt to this machine. Full machine including its top lever ends and all floor feet, and the full person including shoes, must fit completely in frame.
